title: Evaluate Interaction State Audit Prompt
task: In a fictional engineering repository, for a save button, verify focus, duplicate activation, pending state, cancellation, server validation, retry, success announcement, and restored availability rather than only hover styling.
acceptance_criteria: A control-state matrix covering trigger, visuals, semantics, focus, announcement, result, and recovery.
Runtime evidence for primary, loading, error, retry, disabled, and rapid-activation paths.
Source and test references for the state owner and user-observable assertions.
Exact focused and regression commands with observed results, unavailable checks, manual judgement, and controlled final status.
failure_signals: Reject state coverage that checks CSS classes without user-observable behaviour.
Reject controls whose loading, error, disabled, or recovery state is ambiguous.
